description: Keyword variations: long-tail Google searches that contain a seed phrase, each with search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent; up to 100 in one $0.04 call (Google Ads data). Use when you need phrase-match ideas for a keyword, sorted by volume. No matches returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

keyword.description: Seed phrase; every result contains it (at most 80 characters; normalised like keyword-ideas).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum variations to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

name: keyword_variations
title: Keyword variations containing a phrase (up to 100)
